description: Christmas Island Building Outlines 2011 is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Cities and Regional Development. Building polygons were created in February 2013 by Geoscience Australia by manually digitising the outline of each building off the 2011 orthophotography. Digitisation was done from scratch off the 2011 orthophotography within Quantum GIS. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Cities and Regional Development. Its tags are Christmas, IOT, building, topographic. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2022-05-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
